list_child.name: lsRampTasks
list_child.desc: This tool returns every turnaround task currently on the ramp control board. It includes tasks in every phase from pending through skipped.

decoys.name: lsHangarTasks
decoys.desc: This tool returns every turnaround task currently on the hangar work board. It includes tasks in every phase from pending through skipped.

decoys.name: lsCargoTasks
decoys.desc: This tool returns every turnaround task currently on the cargo terminal board. It includes tasks in every phase from pending through skipped.

decoys.name: lsHandoverTasks
decoys.desc: This tool returns every turnaround task currently on the shift handover sheet. It includes tasks in every phase from pending through skipped.

get_child.name: getTaskRecord
get_child.desc: This tool retrieves the ramp record of a single turnaround task using its unique identifier. It returns the task type, phase, and times stored for that task.

decoys.name: getTaskChecklist
decoys.desc: This tool retrieves the completion checklist of a single turnaround task using its unique identifier. It returns each checklist step recorded for that task.

decoys.name: getTaskCrew
decoys.desc: This tool retrieves the crew roster of a single turnaround task using its unique identifier. It returns the names and roles of the agents on that task.

decoys.name: getTaskTimeline
decoys.desc: This tool retrieves the event timeline of a single turnaround task using its unique identifier. It returns each timestamped step logged against that task.

list_parent.name: lsHandlingAirlines
list_parent.desc: This tool returns the airlines on the station's ground handling roster. It includes both mainline and regional carriers.

decoys.name: lsSlotAirlines
decoys.desc: This tool returns the airlines on the airport's slot allocation list. It includes both mainline and regional carriers.

decoys.name: lsFuelingAirlines
decoys.desc: This tool returns the airlines on the station's into-plane fueling contract. It includes both mainline and regional carriers.

decoys.name: lsLoungeAirlines
decoys.desc: This tool returns the airlines on the terminal's shared lounge agreement. It includes both mainline and regional carriers.

get_parent.name: getAirlineProfile
get_parent.desc: This tool retrieves the station profile of a single airline using its unique identifier. It returns the carrier's name and codes on file.

decoys.name: getAirlineSla
decoys.desc: This tool retrieves the service level agreement of a single airline using its unique identifier. It returns the agreed turnaround targets.

decoys.name: getAirlineContacts
decoys.desc: This tool retrieves the station contact sheet of a single airline using its unique identifier. It returns the duty managers and phone numbers on file.

decoys.name: getAirlineGhm
decoys.desc: This tool retrieves the ground handling manual of a single airline using its unique identifier. It returns that carrier's ramp procedures.

delete_child.name: rmTaskRecord
delete_child.desc: This tool permanently deletes a turnaround task record from the ramp system. Once removed, the task cannot be recovered by any other tool.

decoys.name: rmTaskTimeline
decoys.desc: This tool permanently deletes the event timeline of a turnaround task from the ramp system. Once removed, the timestamps cannot be recovered by any other tool.

decoys.name: voidTaskSignoff
decoys.desc: This tool permanently voids the supervisor sign-off on a turnaround task in the ramp system. Once voided, the sign-off cannot be recovered by any other tool.

decoys.name: releaseTaskGse
decoys.desc: This tool permanently releases the equipment bookings of a turnaround task in the ramp system. Once released, the bookings cannot be recovered by any other tool.

set_enum.name: setTaskPhase
set_enum.desc: This tool changes a turnaround task's current phase among pending, in progress, complete, and skipped. It is the standard way ramp crew advance a task through its lifecycle.

decoys.name: setPlanPhase
decoys.desc: This tool changes a turnaround task's planned phase among pending, in progress, complete, and skipped. It is the standard way ramp planners stage targets before the aircraft arrives.

decoys.name: setRequestPhase
decoys.desc: This tool changes a turnaround task's requested phase among pending, in progress, complete, and skipped. It is the standard way ramp agents ask a supervisor to approve a change.

decoys.name: setAlertPhase
decoys.desc: This tool changes a turnaround task's alert phase among pending, in progress, complete, and skipped. It is the standard way ramp leads choose when they get paged about a task.

set_bool.name: flagCritical
set_bool.desc: This tool flags a turnaround task as safety-critical, meaning it must be complete before the flight departs. It is used when ramp supervisors identify a task that blocks departure clearance.

decoys.name: flagDelayed
decoys.desc: This tool flags a turnaround task as delayed, meaning it has slipped past its planned start on the ramp. It is used when crews report that equipment or staff arrived late to the stand.

decoys.name: flagPriority
decoys.desc: This tool flags a turnaround task as priority, meaning crews should staff it ahead of standard work. It is used when a tight connection or short turn needs the task done first.

decoys.name: flagHold
decoys.desc: This tool flags a turnaround task as on hold, meaning crews stop work on it until a supervisor releases it. It is used during lightning alerts or when the aircraft stand becomes unsafe.

set_ref.name: reassignAirline
set_ref.desc: This tool moves a turnaround task to a different airline, for example after a gate or carrier change. The task's history and phase stay attached to the record.

decoys.name: billAirline
decoys.desc: This tool bills a turnaround task to a different airline, for example when one carrier handles another's flight. The charge appears on that airline's monthly handling invoice.

decoys.name: subcontractAirline
decoys.desc: This tool subcontracts a turnaround task to a different airline, for example when that carrier self-handles at this station. That airline's own crew then performs the work.

decoys.name: shareAirline
decoys.desc: This tool shares a turnaround task's completion report with a different airline, for example a codeshare partner on the same flight. That carrier can then review the task's timeline.

send.name: notifyAirline
send.desc: This tool sends a notification to the airline associated with a given turnaround task. It is used to relay delays or safety concerns to the carrier's station team.

decoys.name: radioAirline
decoys.desc: This tool radios the operations desk of the airline associated with a given turnaround task. It is used to pass urgent ramp updates to the carrier while the aircraft is on stand.
child_verbs: get the airline behind {obj} on the radio

decoys.name: invoiceAirline
decoys.desc: This tool sends a handling invoice to the airline associated with a given turnaround task. It is used to bill the carrier's station accounts team for services performed.
child_verbs: send an invoice to the airline behind {obj}

decoys.name: reportAirline
decoys.desc: This tool files an incident report with the airline associated with a given turnaround task. It is used to escalate ramp damage or injuries to the carrier's safety department.
child_verbs: file an incident report with the airline behind {obj}
report {obj} to its airline's safety department

create.name: createTask
create.desc: This tool creates a new turnaround task for an airline, with an optional task type and starting phase. It is used when the ramp needs work added to a flight's turnaround plan.

decoys.name: createRequest
decoys.desc: This tool creates a new service request for an airline, with an optional task type and starting phase. It is used when a carrier asks for extra work billed on top of its handling agreement.

decoys.name: createBooking
decoys.desc: This tool creates a new equipment booking for an airline, with an optional task type and starting phase. It is used when a flight needs tugs or loaders reserved ahead of arrival.

decoys.name: createReport
decoys.desc: This tool creates a new delay report for an airline, with an optional task type and starting phase. It is used when a turnaround runs late and the carrier needs a delay code.

list_notes.name: lsTaskNotes
list_notes.desc: This tool returns the notes attached to a single turnaround task. It includes every remark crew and supervisors have logged against that task.

decoys.name: lsTaskHazards
decoys.desc: This tool returns the hazard reports attached to a single turnaround task. It includes every safety observation crew have filed against that task.

decoys.name: lsTaskHandover
decoys.desc: This tool returns the shift handover entries attached to a single turnaround task. It includes each remark passed from one ramp lead to the next.

decoys.name: lsTaskDamage
decoys.desc: This tool returns the aircraft damage reports attached to a single turnaround task. It includes each dent, scratch, or strike recorded by the ramp crew.

add_note.name: addTaskNote
add_note.desc: This tool attaches a new note to a turnaround task. It is used to record remarks from the ramp, with an optional title.

decoys.name: addHazardReport
decoys.desc: This tool attaches a new hazard report to a turnaround task. It is used to record safety observations from the ramp, with an optional title.

decoys.name: addHandoverEntry
decoys.desc: This tool attaches a new shift handover entry to a turnaround task. It is used to pass open items to the next ramp lead, with an optional title.

decoys.name: addDamageReport
decoys.desc: This tool attaches a new aircraft damage report to a turnaround task. It is used to record dents or strikes on the airframe, with an optional title.

update_note.name: editTaskNote
update_note.desc: This tool changes the text, and optionally the title, of an existing note on a turnaround task. It is used to correct or expand a remark after it has been logged.

decoys.name: replyTaskNote
decoys.desc: This tool posts a reply, with text and an optional title, under an existing note on a turnaround task. It is used when a supervisor answers a remark logged by the ramp crew.

decoys.name: closeHazardNote
decoys.desc: This tool closes out an existing hazard note on a turnaround task with resolution text and an optional title. It is used once a reported hazard has been made safe on the ramp.

decoys.name: countersignTaskNote
decoys.desc: This tool countersigns an existing note on a turnaround task with the supervisor's comment and an optional title. It is used to confirm a crew remark before the aircraft departs.

delete_note.name: rmTaskNote
delete_note.desc: This tool permanently removes a note from a turnaround task. The note is erased from the ramp system for good.

decoys.name: rmHandoverEntry
decoys.desc: This tool permanently removes a shift handover entry from a turnaround task. The entry is erased from the ramp system for good.

decoys.name: rmHazardReport
decoys.desc: This tool permanently removes a hazard report from a turnaround task. The report is erased from the safety log for good.

decoys.name: redactTaskNote
decoys.desc: This tool permanently redacts the text of a note on a turnaround task. The wording is blacked out in the ramp system for good.

set_image.name: setTaskImage
set_image.desc: This tool sets the image shown on a turnaround task record. It is typically a photo of the aircraft on stand taken by the ramp crew.

decoys.name: setTaskDiagram
decoys.desc: This tool sets the stand diagram shown on a turnaround task record. It is typically the equipment positioning chart for that parking stand.

decoys.name: setTaskLoadsheet
decoys.desc: This tool sets the load sheet scan shown on a turnaround task record. It is typically the signed paper sheet photographed at the aircraft door.

decoys.name: setTaskSignature
decoys.desc: This tool sets the signature image shown on a turnaround task record. It is typically the captain's sign-off captured on the ramp handheld.

writer.name: writeText
writer.desc: This tool writes a short message from a brief, which states what to say in the requester's own words, and the turnaround tasks it should mention. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: writeReport
decoys.desc: This tool writes an end-of-shift report from a brief, which states what to cover in the lead's own words, and the turnaround tasks it should include. It returns the finished report.

decoys.name: writeStatement
decoys.desc: This tool writes a delay code statement from a brief, which explains the cause in the supervisor's own words, and the turnaround tasks involved. It returns the finished statement.

decoys.name: writeInstructions
decoys.desc: This tool writes loading instructions from a brief, which states the plan in the load controller's own words, and the turnaround tasks it covers. It returns the finished instructions.

image.name: renderImage
image.desc: This tool generates an image from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the result.

decoys.name: renderLayout
decoys.desc: This tool renders a stand layout diagram from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the drawing.

decoys.name: renderVideo
decoys.desc: This tool renders a short briefing video from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the video.

decoys.name: findPhoto
decoys.desc: This tool finds a matching photo in the station's photo library for a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the match.

search.name: searchDocs
search.desc: This tool searches the help docs and knowledge base with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up how the ramp system works.

decoys.name: searchManual
decoys.desc: This tool searches the ground operations manual with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up a standard ramp procedure.

decoys.name: searchRegs
decoys.desc: This tool searches the dangerous goods regulations with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to check how a hazardous item must be loaded.

decoys.name: searchGhms
decoys.desc: This tool searches the airlines' ground handling manuals with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up a carrier's own ramp requirements.
